2609.06958.title: Mind the Phase: Effective Rank and Representation Health in Legged Locomotion
2609.06958.paper_summary: Reinforcement learning has become the leading paradigm in legged locomotion, enabling complex behaviors from backflips to parkour through massively parallel simulation. Under PPO's non-stationarity, shallow networks remain the de facto architecture, supported by carefully staged curricula and environments, yet the representations these policies learn stay poorly understood, leaving no training-time signal of how they will behave on hardware. In this work, we empirically study locomotion policies through the effective rank of the policy Jacobian and show that conditioning rank on the gait phase exposes architectural structure that global rank averages away. In particular, we find that standard architectural choices, namely layer normalization and residual connections, allocate roughly two more dimensions of effective rank to swing than to stance, which is fully absent in vanilla MLPs. Building on this, we propose a simple recipe that turns these representational signatures into smoother, more reliable sim-to-real transfer. In practice, this results in roughly 3x lower joint jitter that holds from simulation onto a physical Spot, suggesting that representation health is an effective training-time lens to track sim-to-real smoothness.
2609.06958.paper_summary_zh: 強化學習已成為腿部運動的主要範式，通過大規模並行模擬實現從後空翻到跑酷的複雜行為。在PPO的非穩定性下，淺層網絡仍然是事實上的架構，這得益於精心設計的課程和環境，但這些策略學習到的表示仍然不太被理解，沒有任何訓練時期的信號顯示它們在硬體上的行為。在這項工作中，我們通過策略雅可比矩陣的有效秩對運動策略進行實證研究，並顯示在步態階段上進行條件化的秩揭示了全球秩平均所掩蓋的架構結構。特別是，我們發現標準的架構選擇，即層正規化和殘差連接，為擺動分配了大約兩個以上的有效秩維度，而在普通的多層感知器中則完全不存在。在此基礎上，我們提出了一個簡單的配方，將這些表示特徵轉化為更平滑、更可靠的模擬到實際轉移。在實踐中，這導致關節抖動降低了大約3倍，並且從模擬保持到實體Spot，這表明表示健康是一個有效的訓練時期的視角來追蹤模擬到實際的平滑度。
